outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Mireglass Belltoad battle animation sprite sheet from reference. Preserve squat dark warty amphibian, four webbed feet, moss/reed fronds across shoulders, glowing aqua fungi on back, golden-green eyes and THREE adjacent translucent aqua bell-shaped throat sacs. Sixteen complete poses arranged exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, facing RIGHT at consistent elevated three-quarter tactical view, same anatomical scale. Generous empty gutters; each entire toad and every reed tip contained in its cell. Row1: idle low crouch throat sacs gently inflated; breathing sacs slightly smaller; hop anticipation with hindlegs compressed; airborne short hop with forefeet reaching forward and hindlegs extended back. Row2: landing forefeet contacting ground and hindlegs gathering; melee windup leaning back, throat sacs tucked in; short biting/head lunge toward RIGHT with mouth open and forefeet braced; defensive flattened crouch behind folded forelegs. Row3: ranged aim lifting chin and firmly planting forefeet; ranged charge all three glass throat sacs greatly inflated; resonant CROAK release mouth open wide, sacs sharply contracted, cheeks tense, no detached waves; ranged recovery closing mouth and sacs returning to idle. Row4: hit recoil head jerked back; dying legs buckling, throat sacs limp; side collapse with slack webbed feet; final DEAD toad resting flat on belly/side, head on ground, all sacs deflated and faint, feet slack, eyes closed. No blood. Actual limb and throat articulation, not whole-body rotation or scaling copies. Painterly original raster fantasy style matching reference. Flat solid pure green RGB(0,255,0) backdrop everywhere between sprites; no checkerboard, shadows, ground, detached effects, labels or grid.
